name: Pulmonology & asthma care (category guide)
summary: Chronic cough / asthma / sleep-breathing overlap — GP inhaler plans vs respiratory physician, and when ‘cough specialist’ shopping is the wrong door.
body: Respiratory physicians (pulmonology) manage asthma, COPD, interstitial disease, and complex chronic cough after GP work-ups. Forum ‘cough specialist’ threads often need ENT, gastro (reflux), or cardiology instead — start with history and a GP exam before private lung packages. Uncontrolled asthma on guideline inhalers, haemoptysis, or unexplained breathlessness warrants specialist review; sudden severe breathlessness is A&E. Foreigners pay full public fees; private clinics sell speed and lung-function slots. Distinct from sleep-medicine/CPAP listings and from ENT. Category guide, not a ranked lung-clinic list.
